claim: Runs the bundled sample workload without touching an existing workload
sandbox: fresh temporary parent; explicit new demo output; assert manifest, fixture, JSON, and Markdown report

claim: Records SQLite build details, PRAGMAs, query plans, CPU features, pins, timings, and writes JSON and Markdown reports
where: landing evidence strip and hero, README introduction
sandbox: fresh generated workload; run host profile; parse JSON fields and assert the Markdown companion exists

claim: A measured regression above the configured threshold exits with code 2
where: landing hero and method, README Usage and Exit codes
sandbox: fresh generated workload and report; increase the candidate median beyond 15%; assert exit 2 and Gate: FAIL

claim: A changed query result stops report comparison
where: landing Method step 3, README CI pattern
sandbox: fresh generated baseline; alter only the candidate result digest; assert invalid-input exit 1

claim: Check rejects measured SQL that mutates the database without executing it
sandbox: fresh generated manifest; replace measured SELECT with DELETE; assert JSON failure and no stdout

claim: The documentation works offline after the first visit
where: offline status, README Privacy and scope
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:offline-reload
sandbox: fresh browser context; first online visit; wait for service worker; switch context offline; reload

claim: The documentation uses no analytics, cookies, third-party scripts, or remote fonts
where: landing privacy section, README Privacy and scope
test: npm run build:site && npx playwright test --grep @claim:docs-private
sandbox: fresh browser context; capture every request through the sample walkthrough; assert same origin only and no cookies

claim: The CLI has no networking, analytics, crash reporting, or automatic upload
where: CLI help, landing privacy section, README Privacy and scope
sandbox: scan the complete CLI dependency and source surface for networking APIs, then run the bundled demo in a fresh temporary directory
